entities.summary: Paulus Henrique Benedictus Cox, known as Paul Cox, a Dutch photographer with a family background in film and photography who studied in the Netherlands and exhibited pictures from his travels in Asia and Europe, settled in Melbourne, Australia in the mid-1960s.
